command: SELECT ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host, if(Body LIKE '%Timeout while getting execution payload%', 'timeout','proposed') AS kind, count() AS raw_log_rows, count(DISTINCT (Timestamp,Body)) AS unique_events FROM external.otel_logs WHERE ResourceAttributes['network']='glamsterdam-msf-2' AND Timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-12 23:24:13') AND Timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-13 08:30:00') AND ResourceAttributes['host.name']='nimbus-reth-1' AND (Body LIKE '%Timeout while getting execution payload%' OR Body LIKE '%Block proposed%') GROUP BY host, if(Body LIKE '%Timeout while getting execution payload%', 'timeout','proposed') ORDER BY raw_log_rows DESC LIMIT 10
